text: Event type diagnostics for the final benchmark. Panel A is the primary specialist selection frequency heatmap: each cell reports the mean fraction of steps, averaged over 24 seeds, in which the learned policy selects the column specialist during windows of the row event type. Panel B shows per-seed macro margins normalised by static references against the validation-selected fixed mask reference, with each point representing one seed. The heatmap shows regime-dependent specialist use rather than a fixed specialist shortcut.

Event type diagnostics for the final benchmark. Panel A is the
  primary specialist selection frequency heatmap: each cell reports the mean
  fraction of steps, averaged over 24 seeds, in which the learned policy selects
  the column specialist during windows of the row event type. Panel B shows
  per-seed macro margins normalised by static references against the

text: Behavioural diagnostics for the final 24-seed benchmark. Panel A reports seed distributions of three scalar diagnostics: mask entropy for action diversity, event-mask mutual information for state dependence of specialist choice, and sensor-use separation for regime-conditioned specialist concentration. Panel B shows the specialist selection frequency heatmap, the same quantity as Panel A, alongside the scalar diagnostics. The repetition co-locates the visual selection pattern with the quantitative behavioural metrics. The combined evidence rules out a constant mask or a simple periodic rotation as the explanation for the result.
